battle.name: 唐滅西突厥之戰
battle.brief: 顯慶二年（657）末，蘇定方率唐軍與回紇兵北擊西突厥賀魯，曳咥河一戰破十姓之兵十萬，繼而踏雪追奔至金牙山，擒可汗於石國。卡上的亞述長矛非戰場實物，它標示的是矛的形制源頭：短柄只能近身一刺，唐代的長柄大刃槊卻能刺、能挑、能壓，故步兵據南原、攢槊外向便能站住不動。

kit.name: 亞述長矛
kit.history: 短柄、長刃，配著鐵鏃。亞述人把它和弓、鐵器綁在一起，兩河流域的城一個接一個陷落。

countries: 交戰雙方是唐王朝與西突厥汗國，回紇（黠鰲）以同盟兵的身分出戰，並非交戰方。唐廷由高宗李治下詔，以右屯衛大將軍蘇定方為伊麗道行軍大總管，總攬全局；燕然都護任雅相、副都護蕭嗣業與回紇首領婆潤為副總管，右武衛大將軍阿史那彌射與左屯衛大將軍阿史那步真任安撫大使走南道，兵分西州、金城兩道北進。遠征軍後方倚託關內宿衛與十二軍府，糧秣由河西走廊與安西都護府接應，回紇兵隨軍作戰並供應馬匹。西突厥以沙鉢羅可汗賀魯為汗，國力來自十姓十部的聯軍與逐水草而居的游牧動員，營內分可汗牙帳、諸部俟斤與葉護，各部以信騎往來聯絡，沒有固定城池與攻城器械，賀魯自陳十姓之兵十萬。西域小國如石國（鼠耨設）等在兩強之間兩面應酬，靠詐降、閉門拒人與貢使往來求自保。兩套指揮系統在草原上並行：唐軍以鼓角旗幟與牙帳傳令、用人到位次分派任務，西突厥則以牙旗、號角與輕騎傳訊。
countriesEn: The two belligerents were the Tang dynasty and the Western Turkic Khaganate; the Uyghur (Goghturk) fought as allied auxiliaries, not as a party to the war. On the Tang side the expedition was ordered by Emperor Gaozong Li Zhi. Su Dingfang, then commander of the Right Tunwei Guard, was made supreme commander of the Yili Route; the Yanran Protector Ren Yaxiang, the deputy protector Xiao Siye and the Uyghur chief Bolun served as his deputies, while the Right Wuwei commander Ashina Yishe and the Left Tunwei commander Ashina Buzhen were sent as pacification envoys by the southern route, the army itself advancing in two columns, through Xizhou and through Jincheng. Behind the army stood the palace guard of the capital and the twelve army districts; grain came down the Hexi Corridor and from the protectorates of the Western Regions, and the Uyghur auxiliaries marched with the host, fighting and supplying horses. On the Western Turkic side the state rested with Shaaboluo Qaghan Helü, whose strength came from a confederation of the ten tribes and from pastoral mobilisation that followed the water and the grass. Its order ran through the qaghan's tent, the begs of each tribe and the yabghus, with light-rider messengers carrying word between camps; it had no fixed cities and no siege engines, and Helü put his own strength at a hundred thousand men of the ten surnames. The small states of the Western Regions, the state of Shiguo (Soghos) among them, hovered between the two powers, buying survival with feigned surrenders, with gates shut against fugitives and with a constant traffic of tribute and envoys. Two command systems ran in parallel across the steppe: the Tang transmitted orders by drum, horn, banner and command tent, and allotted tasks by rank of appointment, while the Western Turks answered with yak banners, horns and fast riders.
people: 主角是蘇定方。這位唐初名將以分兵合擊與精騎奇襲見長，本戰役被後世視為其戰術樣板：他選在賀魯新敗、部落尚未盡附的窗口出兵，以唐軍主力與回紇騎兵兩路夾擊。副總管蕭嗣業負責追擊殘部，並最終把賀魯解送京師；燕然都護任雅相與回紇首領婆潤分掌一路；安撫大使阿史那彌射、阿史那步真招撫草原各部，事後分立為興昔亡可汗與繼往絕可汗。對面是沙鉢羅可汗阿史那賀魯，他早年受唐冊封，後來叛唐重聚舊部；兵敗後與子咥運、婿閻啜脫走石國，為石國城主伊涅達干以酒食詐誘、閉門執之，檻車送京。他求見昭陵使者向先帝謝罪，高宗愍之詔免其死，顯慶三年十一月獻俘於昭陵樂懸之北。西突厥方面，處木昆部在金山之北先遭破敗，處木昆屈律啜與賀魯數百騎西走；大首領都搭達干等二百餘人被斬，胡祿屋、五努失畢、五咄陸三部相繼歸降。史書於基層將士姓名多不著一字，編組只能從軍制與行程推想。
peopleEn: The central figure is Su Dingfang. This early Tang commander was known for splitting his force to strike from two directions and for fast cavalry raids, and this campaign came to be treated as his tactical model: he chose the moment when Helü, freshly defeated, had not yet gathered all his tribes back to him, and he struck with the main Tang force and the Uyghur cavalry converging from two axes. The deputy Xiao Siye led the pursuit of the broken remnants and finally brought Helü back to the Tang capital in a cage-cart. The Yanran Protector Ren Yaxiang and the Uyghur chief Bolun each commanded one route; the pacification envoys Ashina Yishe and Ashina Buzhen won the tribes of the steppe over, and were afterwards set up as the Qaghan Xingxiwang and the Qaghan Jiwang Jue respectively. On the other side stood Shaaboluo Qaghan Ashina Helü, who had once been invested by Tang and later rebelled, rallying his old followers; after his defeat he fled with his son Yeyun and his son-in-law Yan-chuo to the state of Shiguo, where the governor Inedaqan drew them in with food and wine, shut the gate and took them prisoner. Helü asked to be allowed to send an envoy to the tomb of Taizong to apologise for his wrongs to the former emperor; Gaozong commiserated with him and issued an edict sparing his life, and in the eleventh month of the third year of Xianqing he was presented as a captive at the northern gate of the Zhaoling music terrace. On the Turkic side the tribe of Chamukun was already broken north of Jinshan, and Chamukun Quluzhü fled west with Helü and a few hundred riders; the great leaders Dutadagan and more than two hundred others were killed, and the tribes of Hulùwu, Wunushibi and Wuduoluo surrendered in turn. The histories hardly record the names of the rank and file at all, and the organisation of the army can only be inferred from the army system and the itinerary of the march.
kits: 本卡兵器是亞述長矛，即兩河流域北部亞述帝國（約公元前九至前七世紀）步兵所用的冷兵器：短柄、長刃，寬葉形矛頭以鐵鏃安於木柄前端；亞述人把矛同弓、鐵器捆在一處作戰，配直刃短劍與圓盾、高盾，密集方陣前推時矛尖外向、盾牆在前，後排以弓箭掩護。要說明的是，亞述長矛並不在西元六百五十七年唐軍的裝備表上；它在此標示的，是「矛」這一類冷兵器在形制譜系上的源頭位置。亞述的短柄長刃矛講的是「一次近身刺擊」：刃長便於刺穿，但柄短，刺完要退回原位重新發力，必須靠密集陣形與盾牆把人貼上去。同一件「矛」到了唐代，長成柄長刃寬的步槊，刺、挑、壓、勾四種用法集於一身——刺可以破甲，挑可以掀落騎兵，壓可以硬吃住衝鋒而不退。曳咥河之役的唐軍正是靠後者：步兵據南原、攢槊外向，線不動而敵三衝不入；其後的槊兵與騎兵才得反手突出。與此同時，唐軍還有明光鎧（山字甲亮甲）、皮甲、兜鍪、直刃橫刀、十二銳銅錘、角製或膠合弓臂的弓，以及弩與大量箭矢；西突厥與回紇騎兵則以複合反曲弓、骨製與鐵製箭鏃、皮甲札甲、鋼刀與短柄標槍為主，馬具用皮鞍與木鞍橋。唐軍真正的短板是馬，遠征兵萬餘騎多靠回紇供馬與充作先鋒；攻城器械基本沒有派上用場，賀魯被擒靠的是石國的一次詐降，不是一場攻城。
kitsEn: The weapon on this card is the Assyrian spear, the cold weapon carried by the infantry of the Assyrian Empire of northern Mesopotamia, roughly the ninth to seventh centuries BCE: a short shaft and a long blade, with a broad leaf-shaped head fitted to the top of the wooden shaft by an iron head. The Assyrians tied the spear together with bow and iron implements to fight with it, pairing it with straight-edged short swords and with round or tall shields, and in a dense formation advancing in step the points faced outward with a wall of shields in front and archers in the rear giving cover. It should be said plainly that the Assyrian spear was not in the equipment list of the Tang army in 657 CE. What it marks here is the place of the spear family of cold weapons at the head of a lineage of forms. The short-shafted, long-bladed Assyrian spear stands for a single thrust delivered at close quarters: the long blade is made to pierce, but the short haft means the thrower must fall back and wind up again, so the weapon only works inside a mass formation pressed against the enemy behind a shield wall. The same spear in Tang times grew into the step spear, with a long haft and a broad blade, carrying four uses in one piece: the thrust to break armour, the lift to throw a horseman down, the press to absorb a charge without giving ground, and the hook to pull a rider out of the saddle. The Tang army at the Yitish River relied on the latter: infantry on the southern rise with their spears turned outward, the line holding while three charges failed to break it, and only then the spearmen and the horse could strike out in counterattack. Alongside this the Tang had bright armour in the mountain-patterned gleaming plate, leather armour, helmets, straight-edged sabres, twelve-flanged bronze maces, bows with horn or glued composite limbs, and crossbows with a large stock of arrows. The Western Turks and the Uyghur horsemen fought with composite recurve bows, bone and iron arrowheads, leather and lamellar armour, steel knives and short javelins, and rode with leather saddles on wooden saddle-trees. The real weakness of the Tang force was horses: the tens of thousands of riders in the expedition depended on the Uyghur for mounts and for the vanguard. Siege engines played almost no part at all; Helü was taken in a single piece of deception by the governor of Shiguo, not by any storming of a city.
tactics: 這場戰役的戰術骨架是分進合擊加縱深拒止。蘇定方不把萬餘人押在一條路上：兵分西州、金城兩道，主力自昆陵、庭州一帶北進，回紇兵另由雙河南下，兩軍約期會合，會師後形成南北夾擊，令賀魯無法集中兵力應付單一方向。曳咥河之戰，敵四面圍之，唐軍步兵據南原、攢槊外向立成拒止線，蘇定方自領漢騎陳北原，敵三衝不入；騎兵由正面突出，追奔三十里，斬首數萬級，斬大首領都搭達干等二百餘人。次日胡祿屋、五努失畢悉眾降，五咄陸部亦聞敗降步真，處木昆屈律啜與賀魯數百騎西走。追擊段更見機動力：蕭嗣業與婆潤趨邪羅斯川追北，蘇定方與任雅相領新附之眾繼之，遇大雪平地二尺（《冊府元龜》作三尺），軍中請停候晴，蘇定方以「省日兼功在此舉也」壓下異議，蹋雪晝夜兼行，至雙河與彌射、步真會師，再去牙帳百餘里（《資治通鑑》作二百里），長驅金牙山，掩其不備，破其牙帳，生擒數萬人，獲其鼓纛器械。賀魯最後不是被攻破的城池交出來的，而是在石國一場酒食詐誘中被執。攻城器械基本無用武之地，取勝全靠騎兵機動與槊線拒止。
tacticsEn: The tactical skeleton of this campaign was a convergence from two directions combined with a deep refusal line. Su Dingfang would not put his ten thousand men on a single road: the army advanced in two columns, through Xizhou and through Jincheng, the main body moving north out of the Kunling and Tingzhou area while the Uyghur horse came down separately from the Two Rivers, the two columns timed to join so that after the junction they formed a pincer from north and south and Helü could never mass his strength against a single axis. At the battle on the Yitish River the enemy surrounded the Tang on four sides. Tang infantry took up the southern rise and stood with their spears turned outward as a refusal line, Su Dingfang himself led the Han horse on the northern rise, and three charges failed to get in. The cavalry then struck out from the front, pursued for thirty li, cut down tens of thousands and killed great leaders including Dutadagan and more than two hundred others. The next day the tribes of Hulùwu and Wunushibi came in with all their people, and the tribe of Wuduoluo, hearing of the defeat, came over to Buzhen, while Chamukun Quluzhü and Helü rode west with a few hundred horsemen. The pursuit shows the mobility of the force even better: Xiao Siye and Bolun chased north up the Yeruosi river, Su Dingfang and Ren Yaxiang followed leading the newly surrendered people, and they met a heavy fall of snow two chi deep on the level ground, three chi in the Ceifu Yuangui. The army asked to halt and wait for clear weather; Su Dingfang put down the objection with the words that the whole gain of days lay in this one move, and marched on through the snow day and night, joined the forces of Yishe and Buzhen at the Two Rivers, went on within a hundred li of the yak tent, two hundred li in the Comprehensive Mirror, and made a long rush to Jinyashan, taking the enemy by surprise, breaking the yak tent and taking tens of thousands prisoner, with drums, banners and equipment taken as booty. Helü in the end was not handed over by a city that had been stormed; he was taken in a piece of deception with food and wine at Shiguo. Siege engines played almost no part; the victory rested entirely on cavalry mobility and on the refusing line of spears.
data: 可核的數字都帶出處。兵員方面，資治通鑑與唐史記唐軍與回紇兵合「萬餘」，賀魯自陳「十姓兵十萬」；後世史家多認為十萬仍有誇飾，實際列陣當在數萬之譜。戰果方面，曳咥河一役斬首數萬級，斬大首領都搭達干等二百餘人，追奔三十里；金牙山破牙帳，生擒數萬人，獲鼓纛器械；舊唐書本紀記「收其人畜前後四十餘萬」。編制方面，安撫大使彌射、步真走南道，唐軍分西州、金城兩道；侯斤懶獨祿率萬餘帳降，發其千騎進至突騎施部。行程方面，自昆陵出發、會師曳咥河、追至雙河與金牙山，再西至石國，曳咥河至石國直線距離逾一千五百公里，全程數千里；時間上正月下詔出師、十二月會戰，顯慶三年十一月獻俘昭陵。損耗方面，唐軍自身傷亡舊新史書均不記載；反倒是前一年（656）程知節征賀魯失利時，副總管王文度矯詔收軍不深入，士卒終日跨馬被甲、馬多瘦死，可見遠征草原的騎兵代價。雪深與路程亦有數：雪深二尺（《冊府元龜》作三尺），距牙帳百餘里（《資治通鑑》作二百里）。
dataEn: Every figure that can be checked carries its source. On strength, the Comprehensive Mirror and the Tang histories give ten thousand for the Tang and Uyghur troops together, and Helü put his own force at a hundred thousand men of the ten surnames; later historians have generally held that even the hundred thousand is inflated and that the line actually deployed numbered tens of thousands. On results, the Yitish engagement cut down tens of thousands, killed great leaders including Dutadagan and more than two hundred others, and pursued for thirty li; the breaking of the yak tent at Jinyashan took tens of thousands prisoner and yielded drums, banners and equipment. The Old Book of Tang annals records that people and livestock were taken to the number of more than four hundred thousand in all. On organisation, the pacification envoys Yishe and Buzhen took the southern route while the army moved in two columns, through Xizhou and through Jincheng; the beg Lan Dulu surrendered with more than ten thousand tents and a thousand of his horsemen were sent on against the Tujishi. On distances, the army left Kunling, joined at the Yitish River, pursued to the Two Rivers and Jinyashan, and then west to Shiguo; the straight line from the Yitish to Shiguo is more than a thousand five hundred kilometres, and the whole route ran to several thousand. On time, the order to mobilise went out in the first month, the battle was fought in the twelfth, and the captives were presented at the Zhaoling in the eleventh month of the third year of Xianqing. On losses, neither the old nor the new histories records Tang casualties; it is the previous year, 656, that shows the price of campaigning on the steppe, when the deputy Wang Wendu, jealous of credit, issued a forged order to halt the advance and the soldiers spent whole days mounted and armoured, so that many horses died of exhaustion. There are figures for the snow and the distance as well: snow two chi deep, three in the Ceifu Yuangui, and a hundred li short of the yak tent, two hundred in the Comprehensive Mirror.
cause: 這場戰爭不是唐廷突然發難，而是數十年西域經營與賀魯反覆叛離累積的結果。唐自貞觀末滅東突厥、平高昌置西州與安西都護府之後，勢力伸到天山南北，但西突厥汗國仍控弦於漠北與西域西部，既向唐朝貢又與吐蕃往來，商道與使節之路屢受威脅。直接導火線是前一年的失利：顯慶元年（656）左衛大將軍程知節掛帥、蘇定方為前軍總管征賀魯，陰山、牙山兩破之，鷹娑川遇突厥二萬騎相持不下，鼠尼施又率二萬餘騎來援，蘇定方以五百精騎越嶺馳擊，追奔二十里、殺一千五百餘人、獲馬二千匹，敵棄甲仗器械不可勝計；可惜副大總管王文度妒功矯詔收軍不深入，士卒終日跨馬被甲、馬多瘦死，又在怛篤城殺降附胡人，十二月無功而還，文度除名、知節免官。於是顯慶二年（657）正月再出師，蘇定方掛伊麗道行軍大總管，兵分西州、金城兩道，安撫大使走南道招撫諸部，並借回紇的騎兵與馬匹補足唐軍最缺的機動力，趁賀魯新敗、人心未附，一戰打在冬季封閉草原之前。
causeEn: This war was not a sudden stroke by the Tang court. It was the accumulated result of decades of engagement in the Western Regions and of Helü's repeated departures from Tang allegiance. After extinguishing the Eastern Turks late in the Zhenguan era and taking Gaochang, where Xizhou and the Protectorate of the Western Regions were established, Tang power reached north and south of the Tianshan, but the Western Turkic Khaganate still held the bow across the steppe and the west of the Western Regions, paying tribute to Tang while also dealing with Tibet, and the caravan roads and the road of envoys were repeatedly threatened. The immediate occasion was the failure of the previous year. In 656, the first year of Xianqing, the Left Ward commander Cheng Zhijie took overall command with Su Dingfang as commander of the vanguard against Helü. They broke him twice, at Yinshan and at Yashan; at Eriorshui they were held off by two thousand Turkic horsemen, and Shunish and others came up with more than twenty thousand to reinforce him, whereupon Su Dingfang took five hundred picked horsemen over the ridge, pursued for twenty li, killed more than fifteen hundred and captured two thousand horses, the enemy abandoning armour, arms and equipment beyond counting. But the deputy Wang Wendu, jealous of the credit, forged an order to halt the advance and did not press on; the soldiers spent whole days mounted and armoured and many horses died of exhaustion, and at Dadu city he killed surrendered and surrendered-again tribesmen against Su Dingfang's remonstrance. In the twelfth month the expedition returned with nothing to show, Wendu was struck from the rolls and Zhijie was relieved of command. So in the first month of 657, the second year of Xianqing, the expedition went out again: Su Dingfang took command of the Yili Route, the army moved in two columns through Xizhou and Jincheng, pacification envoys went by the southern road to win the tribes over, and the Uyghur cavalry and horses were borrowed to make up the mobility the Tang most lacked, striking while Helü was still fresh from defeat and before the winter closed the steppe.
impact: 西突厥汗國的牙帳被拔，汗位虛置。善後做法在唐史上寫得很清楚：蘇定方令諸部各歸所居，開通道路置郵驛，掩埋骸骨，劃定疆場，括還被掠人畜，使「十姓安堵如故」；唐廷分立彌射為興昔亡可汗、步真為繼往絕可汗，置濛池、昆陵二都護府，天山南北的城邑、部落與戶口自此編入版籍，絲路北道在一個可預期的框架內運轉，直到八世紀前期局面大致穩定。這也讓唐在西域的經營從羈縻名義走向都護府實治，為此後唐將在西域的經營，以及唐與吐蕃在西域漫長的角力，鋪下地盤與制度。對草原勢力而言，唐廷在這場戰爭中確認了回紇作為盟軍的價值，靠他們的馬匹與騎兵才湊得出深入漠北的機動力，漠北的權力天平也由此再向回紇傾斜，而這正是數十年後回紇介入中原的遠因。對唐軍自身，蘇定方以萬餘人破十萬眾、踏雪追奔千里的名例，成為「奇兵深入」的樣板，其後三年平百濟、再後平高句麗，都被視為同一套本事的延伸。對吐蕃而言，北方少了一個可以拉攏的對手，唐的高昌與安西防線反而暴露在新的壓力之下，咸亨年間西域四鎮的失守與其後的反攻，源於此。
impactEn: The tent of the Western Turkic Khaganate was pulled down and the khaganate left vacant. The Tang histories set out the settlement in plain terms: Su Dingfang ordered the tribes each back to their own lands, opened roads and established post stations, buried the bones, marked out the frontier, and restored the people and livestock taken away, so that the ten surnames might be left unmoved, each in the place they had held. The court set up Yishe as the Qaghan Xingxiwang and Buzhen as the Qaghan Jiwang Jue, and established the two protectorates of Haochi and Kunling; the towns, tribes and households north and south of the Tianshan entered the registers from that point, and the northern road of the silk routes ran thereafter inside a predictable framework, broadly stable until the early eighth century. Tang rule in the Western Regions thus moved from nominal dependency to real administration through the protectorates, laying down both the ground and the institutions for later Tang campaigning there and for the long struggle between Tang and Tibet over the same country. As for the balance of power on the steppe, the Tang court had measured the worth of the Uyghur as allies, and only their horses and their horse could make a deep thrust into the northern steppe possible at all; the balance tilted further towards the Uyghur, and that tilt was a distant cause of the Uyghur intervention in the Central Plains decades later. For the Tang army itself, Su Dingfang's example of ten thousand men beating a hundred thousand and pursuing through the snow for a thousand li became a model of striking deep with a picked force; his reduction of Baekje three years later and of Goguryeo after that are read as extensions of the same gift. For Tibet, the north had lost a partner it might court, while the Gaochang and Western Regions lines of the Tang lay exposed to fresh pressure, which is where the loss of the four garrisons in the Western Regions in the Xianheng era and the counter-offensive that followed had their origin.
result: 曳咥河之戰，唐軍與回紇兵萬餘人破賀魯十姓之兵十萬，斬首數萬級，斬大首領都搭達干等二百餘人，追奔三十里；金牙山破其牙帳，生擒數萬人，獲鼓纛器械；賀魯與處木昆屈律啜數百騎西走，終在石國被城主伊涅達干詐誘執獲，檻送京師。顯慶三年十一月，獻俘於昭陵樂懸之北，攝刑部尚書長孫沖跪奏；高宗愍其請罪之請，詔免其死。行政上的收尾同步展開：置濛池、昆陵二都護府，分立彌射、步真為可汗，諸部各歸所居、置郵驛、開道路、劃疆場、括還被掠人畜。第二次唐滅西突厥的軍事行動，至此告一段落。史書對唐軍自身損失多不著一字，記傳體例如此，實際數字已不可考；而以少擊眾、追擒其首的敘事在唐宋兩代史家筆下反覆被複述，成為這場戰爭最牢固的史學記憶。
resultEn: At the battle on the Yitish River ten thousand Tang and Uyghur troops broke Helü's hundred thousand men of the ten surnames, cutting down tens of thousands, killing great leaders including Dutadagan and more than two hundred others, and pursuing for thirty li. At Jinyashan the yak tent was broken, tens of thousands were taken prisoner, and drums, banners and equipment were captured. Helü and Chamukun Quluzhü rode west with a few hundred horsemen and were finally taken at Shiguo, where the governor Inedaqan drew them in with food and wine and shut the gate on them, and they were carried to the capital in a cage-cart. In the eleventh month of the third year of Xianqing the captives were presented at the northern gate of the Zhaoling music terrace, with the acting Minister of Justice Changsun Chong kneeling to make the report; Gaozong was moved by Helü's plea to apologise to the former emperor and issued an edict sparing his life. The administrative settlement ran in parallel: the two protectorates of Haochi and Kunling were established, Yishe and Buzhen were set up as qaghans, the tribes were sent back each to their own lands, post stations were set up, roads opened, the frontier marked out, and the people and livestock taken away were restored. The second military action by which the Tang destroyed the Western Turks was at an end. The histories write down almost nothing about Tang losses, which is a matter of biographical convention; the real figures cannot be recovered. The narrative of a few beating many and of the enemy ruler hunted down was nevertheless repeated by Tang and Song historians alike, and it became the firmest historical memory this war left behind.
